codeReview.summary: The feature removes the targeted unsafe non-null assertions in oauth and ai/sdk by validating nullable config inputs before use. Current repository state shows explicit guards for redirectUri, deviceCodeUrl, and proxyBaseUrl, no remaining non-null assertions in the targeted directories, and focused regression coverage for all three guard paths.
